failure_observation_review.finding: Harmless diagnostic sentinel; not a failure.
failure_observation_review.basis: The driver assigns report.failure_observation after each successful waitForTerminalAnswer, including before the try block can fail. On the final successful post-reload follow-up, the diagnostic snapshot therefore contains that real latest assistant answer. Its answerMatchesPublicStages/answerStagesInOrder flags evaluate the opening-answer rubric, whereas this distinct follow-up asks for the separate follow-up code and heading. Those flags are false as expected; the follow-up-specific assertions and receipt booleans are true, the verdict is terminal_answer, and the screenshot shows the page-grounded heading answer.

screenshot_review.result: Screenshots show guest side panel and portions of each real assistant response; page codes are redacted in receipt and named in screenshot only via controlled synthetic fixture.

verification.artifact: Downloaded and inspected hosted result and release artifacts; release receipt binds Store ZIP hash and version.
verification.resource_finals: Matched all three journal final decisions in downloaded journals and workflow logs.
verification.source: Read the exact browser driver predicates and observed how success-path failure_observation is assigned; no tests run for this read-only evidence review.

limitations: The tested artifact is the exact Store ZIP loaded unpacked with a candidate key adaptation; this is not an actual Chrome Web Store installed-copy test.
Only bounded EXT-F-2013-T10 public guest Chat behavior is credited.
